**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-375165, Reactome:R-HSA-445095, Reactome:R-HSA-5673001, Reactome:R-HSA-6807878)

**Proposed mechanism:** SPTA1 mutation (null) —DISRUPTS→ SPTA1 (HGNC:11272); SPTA1 (HGNC:11272) —PRODUCES→ alpha-spectrin (HGNC:11272); alpha-spectrin (HGNC:11272) —DISRUPTS→ Erythrocyte membrane structural integrity (REACT:R-HSA-75171); Erythrocyte membrane structural integrity (REACT:R-HSA-75171) —LEADS_TO→ Hemolytic anemia (HP:0001892); Erythrocyte membrane structural integrity (REACT:R-HSA-75171) —LEADS_TO→ Poikilocytosis (HP:0000970); Erythrocyte membrane structural integrity (REACT:R-HSA-75171) —LEADS_TO→ Spherocytosis (HP:0004465).
